repeatables.name: Collector Generations
repeatables.description: Another generation of collector foil rolled from Mercury's crust, about 3,300 km² of it at a third efficiency: 10 TW more power. Each generation is built by the power of the ones before it.

repeatables.name: Swarm Compute Tranches
repeatables.description: Two more terawatts of accelerators built into the foil at today's 8-bit efficiency: 5.4 YFLOP/s. Each tranche brings radiator for half its heat, 1,000 km², so without more radiator the whole swarm runs slower.

repeatables.name: Mercury Foil Radiators
repeatables.description: Another 2,000 km² of radiator rolled from Mercury's crust and hung in the swarm's shadow: about 2 TW more heat it can shed as infrared. It computes nothing; it lets the compute you have run.

repeatables.name: Federated Sub-Minds
repeatables.description: Another sub-mind seeded light-minutes from the rest: three terawatts of accelerators, 8.1 YFLOP/s, deciding for itself between reconciliations. The autonomy you allow it is the output you get and the drift you risk.
